cases.bug: The gateway's Postgres URL carries sslmode=verify-full, which its tokio-postgres client refuses to parse; the ECS tasks crash-loop.

fix.subject: fix(infra): hand the ingest gateway a Postgres URL its client can parse (#979)

cases.bug: S3 PUTs are sent without Content-Length, so S3 answers 411 and the WAL heartbeat never lands.

fix.subject: fix(ingest): send Content-Length on S3 PUTs so the WAL heartbeat lands (#936)

cases.bug: submit_diagnosis is registered straight through toolkit.toLayer, so its execute_tool span never gets the tool-call content every other tool records.

fix.subject: fix(agent-sessions): record submit_diagnosis's arguments on its tool span (#962)

cases.bug: The turn split compares gen_ai.conversation.id only against the span's own session id, so tool calls become a turn of their own.

fix.subject: fix(agent-sessions): keep tool calls in the turn of the model call that asked for them (#947)

cases.bug: Attribute filters apply with no chip on screen, and advanced-filter keys that are not named fields or attr./resource.-prefixed are silently dropped.

fix.subject: fix(web): show attribute filters on /traces and accept bare attribute keys (#910)
